corrections: LP and QP use explicit multiplier sign conversion; LP primal/dual variables kept distinct.
LP central complementarity is an actual gap only at primal and dual feasible points.
Barrier product is a defining identity, not a stationarity certificate; actual one-dimensional gap includes squared stationarity residual.
QP reduced-Hessian positive definiteness distinguished from full-Hessian positive definiteness.
Exact penalty local exactness conditioned on constraint qualification and second-order assumptions.
Nonlinear interior/SQP global convergence is not general nonconvex global optimality.
checks: Gradient and Hessian of nonlinear least squares independently differentiated.
Newton root direction tested with the residual-norm slope identity.
One-dimensional quadratic penalty counterexample analytically solved.
Chapter/small-section printed offsets verified against exact local contents.
limits: Notes, all exercises and historical bibliography are not separately taught.
Full long convergence proofs, all algorithm pseudocode and production software are not reproduced.
Application connections are illustrative additions within textbook sections; the books are not full INS/DL/control courses.
